_doc: Source of truth for the debug_royalty_pipeline task. inputs/ and expected/ are GENERATED from this file by build_cases.py -- edit here, never there.
_domain: Synthetic digital-media publisher royalty accounting. Two reports use DIFFERENT lookup paths: publisher_statement uses LOOKUP (catalog[product_id] -> suppliers[supplier_id] -> name), itemised_statement reads BAKED text from transactions. A ticket asks for a change; agent must produce the minimal edit set so BOTH reports come out consistent. The two reports must be fixed via DIFFERENT edits because they read supplier/sku from different sources.

cases.ticket: Nebula Runner sales are being misattributed to North Rock Media — they should be attributed to Meridian Group. Please correct.

Midnight Cartographer sales from 2024-06-01 onwards are being misattributed to BlueWave Records — from that date on, they should be attributed to Meridian Group. Please correct (sales before 2024-06-01 stay as-is).
River of Stones's SRP has been renegotiated to 2x the current recorded price. Please correct all affected sale prices and ensure royalty reflects the new pricing.
Voidwalker's royalty terms have been renegotiated from 80% to a fixed $2 per sale. Please update.
